reviews.title: Excellent buy, great fan!
reviews.comment: Excellent fans! I bought 2 for my wife's case. They more air well, are quiet, and balanced well. The RGB looks great! 10 of 10!
reviews.author: Brent

reviews.title: Amazing 200mm fans - great cost and performance
reviews.comment: Used to replace my Cooler Master 200mm fans NON rgb. These fans have great RGB and higher air flow, lower noise in comparison to the cooler master fans. Highly recommend these fans for cases capable of using 200mm fans
reviews.author: JM

reviews.title: Perfect Thermaltake fans for Thermaltake case.
reviews.comment: These are very nice 200mm fans. The RGB works great, and they max out at about 900 rpm, and they actually fit my case, which I wasn't sure about after reading reviews, whether I would have issues, but they fit fine. My case is a Thermaltake Core X71, so if you happen to have one of those,  these fans fit perfectly.
reviews.author: NecroWolf

reviews.title: Great Product
reviews.comment: Great fan and works awesome. I got it to hang over the bed to control the wifes hot flashes and it works good..lol naaa it was a replacement for an old case I am putting back into service. I needed two but forgot to change the order. It works great and moves a ton of air.
reviews.author: Warren L.

reviews.title: Quiet
reviews.comment:
It deserves 5 stars but, 1 of the 4 screws has no thread. The long screws go past the fan but are too skinny and would need to get nuts.
The rubber corners adds 1/4” but no turbulence noise. Cools my GPU and cpu cooler.
